liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Eyes of the World is called one of the best ever; The transition from Eyes of the World to China Doll is exceptional [13][15]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Mexicali Blues is a wild rolling polka where Jerry sounds like a tuba [14]
- **China Doll** (1 review): The performance of China Doll is described as beautiful by the listener [9]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha, Truckin', and Brokedown Palace are highlighted as essential listening moments [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-10-29.sbd.miller.32352.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 179 min; rated 4.56/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: El Paso is an audience recording, while the rest of the show is soundboard; Most audience patches are short, but El Paso is a long exception; Bass and keyboards are described as fantastic in this recording [7][10][12]
- **gd1973-10-29.116118.aud.cousinit.flac16**: audience recording; 26 songs; 168 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: The audience recording has static, matching the wind outside the cabin [18]
- **gd1973-10-29.sbd.kaplan.1070.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 175 min; rated 4.23/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Instrument separation is nice, allowing Bobby to be heard clearly [17]
- **gd1973-10-29.set2.131458.McIlhenny.flac16**: source not stated; 11 songs; 100 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]

## Around the show

- A beautiful motorcycle was on stage near the band, gone the next night [6]
- This show has more energy than the following night, October 30th [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-10-29.sbd.miller.32352.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7inch Master Reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> DCassette (Tascam 122mkIII) -> Dat (Panasonic 3700/44.1k) D [1]. Also: El Paso is a complete song patched from a second-generation audience source [1]
- **gd1973-10-29.116118.aud.cousinit.flac16**: transferred by CousinIt; source: Taper: Unknown; Source: Unknown Mics and Deck>??>C>WAV>FLAC; Transferred and Encoded by Cousinit [4]
- **gd1973-10-29.sbd.kaplan.1070.shnf**: transferred by Thanks to Seth Kaplan for providing this show! Extraction and  SHN encoding of the source discs was done by S. Kaplan. Info file and notes by G.S. Hamilton; source: Reel master > 1 cassette gen > DAT > CD > SHN [5]
- **gd1973-10-29.set2.131458.McIlhenny.flac16**: taped by Chaffe McIlhenny; transferred by Chaffe McIlhenny; source: Set 2, Handheld Sony 1 point stereo mic from the 5th and 4th row sometimes standing on chair; Recorderd and transferred by Chaffe McIlhenny; Master… [6]. Also: The recording has a cut in Big River at 1:14 and between songs [6]
